name: Nāpali Coast
bestView: From the water: the sunset catamaran past the fluted cliffs. On land: Pu'u O Kila lookout when the clouds lift
bestMonths: May to September (calm seas). Winter closes the coast to boats
crowd: Kalalau Trail permits sell out months ahead. Boat tours are the quiet loophole: fewer people, better angle
kid: Boat trips run from age 5. Snorkel stops in the lee of the cliffs are calm and full of turtles
priceNote: Hawaii hotel prices bite. Renting a cottage on the north shore often beats a resort for a family of four.

visa.note: ESTA for visa-waiver countries (apply 72h+ before), otherwise a B-2 visa via interview.
